factual_coverage: Binary per explicit family-aspect unit: count only if the material point, attribution and essential qualification are preserved and supported. No credit from lexical overlap alone.
primary_coverage_report: Per-question/cohort family macro average over eligible reference units; also show unit coverage and reference-aspect coverage. Do not mix controls or proposals into factual coverage.
theme_note: Reference aspects are human-defined descriptive keys, not the thematic retriever's cluster labels; not a universal or exhaustive theme taxonomy.
empty_denominator: null / not applicable, never automatic zero or one; disclose eligible families and units.
support_groups: All groups required, at least one review per group. Contrasting experiences across reviews require both sides. One review can itself support both sides.
availability_limit: Availability checks retain known supporting reviews only. Missing anchors do not establish absent themes. New supporting evidence requires explicit adjudication and provenance before crediting an unavailable unit.
retrieval_vs_answer: Judge whether actual retrieved passages cover each unit separately from whether the generated answer covers it. Review identity alone does not prove passage coverage.
factual_claim_note: Separate assertions; judge evidence, negation, experience source, family and version. Plausible improvements are hypotheses, not established outcomes. Missing or incomplete annotation yields null metrics.
citation_note: An existing citation ID is insufficient: manually check that its passage supports the assertion. Distinguish answer grounding from citation adequacy.
criteria_scale: true / false / null (unreviewed or not applicable, reason required). Report each criterion separately; no weighted total.
proposal_note: Accept alternative supported proposals. Do not require the example solution. Do not score speculative trade-offs as technical facts. Questions are scored per answer, not five repeated copies of the same control.
reference_gaps: P and N cells are excluded from factual denominators; neither establishes corpus absence. H is evaluated using proposal criteria and C using control criteria.
additional_evidence: Accept valid evidence outside the audited reference for faithfulness. Reference coverage remains explicitly non-exhaustive. Document corrections before method disclosure; do not silently tune denominators to a preferred method.
aggregation: Pair methods within cohort/question/corpus/repetition. Average repetitions within question before uncertainty summaries. Report case studies separately and disclose question dependence; no causal generalization from three cohorts.
blind_review: Hide method labels and cluster scores; user familiarity means no claim of fully independent or complete blinding.
